messages:
elena: FYI incoming escalation from AcmeCorp — their Feb invoice shows ~1.2M tokens billed but their VPC dashboard and our meter show ~820k. Customer on private deploy with agent v1.4.7 in eu-west-1. They reported a brief network partition last Thursday and a bunch of 429s before traffic resumed.
owen: can you paste the agent logs (the reconnect/replay window) and the agent's system time? which nodes were behind NAT?
elena: attaching a log excerpt below (redacted). key lines: 
```
2026-02-19T03:12:43Z agent=redwood-az3 seq=105234 buffered_event_count=324
2026-02-19T03:12:44Z agent=redwood-az3 conn=lost reason=network-unreachable
2026-02-19T03:14:10Z agent=redwood-az3 conn=restored replay_started seq=105235
2026-02-19T03:14:12Z agent=redwood-az3 replay_event seq=105235 event_id=evt_9f2a ack=none
2026-02-19T03:14:13Z agent=redwood-az3 replay_event seq=105236 event_id=evt_9f2b ack=none
2026-02-19T03:14:13Z collector=eu-west-1 receive event_id=evt_9f2a tokens=127
2026-02-19T03:14:13Z collector=eu-west-1 receive event_id=evt_9f2a tokens=127
```
(see duplicate receives). Also `sudo date -R` on the host returned `Thu, 19 Feb 2026 03:07:12 +0000` while logs show event timestamps ~03:12 — looks like agent clock was ~5 minutes behind before reconnect.
cs_jess: customer also exported their own usage CSV and says the invoice matches the billing export (we think collector count) but dashboard (frontend aggregate) shows fewer tokens — they want explanation and a credit if duplicates are on us.
owen: this looks like classic clock-skew + replay duplication. Collector dedupe uses (event_id + agent_id) + 30s dedupe window for v2 ingestion. If an agent replays events with original timestamps that are behind the collector's wall clock, events can fall outside the dedupe window and be accepted as new. Agent v1.4.7 does not include a `replay_id` handshake; that was introduced in v1.4.8 to make replays idempotent.
metering-bot: note: agent-release v1.4.8 introduced replay_id and server-side dedupe fix; v1.4.9 adds stronger seq-gap alerts.
elena: customer is on 1.4.7 -> recommend upgrade to 1.4.9. For immediate reconciliation we need audit logs from the agent and collector to identify duplicate event_ids.
owen: repro steps to validate locally: 
1) set agent system clock back 5m (`sudo date -s "$(date -u -d '-5 minutes')"`)
2) generate ~2k small requests to the model while network is up (these will be buffered)
3) simulate network partition for ~3m (iptables DROP)
4) restore network and let agent replay
Observe collector receives duplicates if replay handshake missing.
elena: quick commands for customer to run and return: `sudo date -R`, `journalctl -u redwood-meter-agent -o cat --since "2026-02-19 02:50" --until "2026-02-19 03:30" > agent_excerpt.log`, and `redwood-agent audit --json --since 2026-02-19T02:50Z --until 2026-02-19T03:30Z > audit.json`
cs_jess: I'll ask AcmeCorp to run those and upload artifacts. They can run the audit even while the agent is running; it snapshots local queue.
owen: interim mitigation for duplicates: run a collector-side reconcile that dedupes on event_id across a wider time window and mark duplicates for credit. Command we use internally: `redwood-reconcile --collector eu-west-1 --start 2026-02-19T02:50Z --end 2026-02-19T03:30Z --dedupe-window 600 --out duplicates.json`
elena: filed billing case BILL-4321 and internal INFRA-2789 to backfill dedupe and issue provisional credit if duplicates confirmed. Requested priority P1.
oncall-qa: also adding an automated alert: if agent seq gap >1000 or local clock skew >120s between agent and NTP, send page to infra. I'll add rule to monitoring.
elena: pov: long-term fix = require replay_id and server-side replay-id dedupe (already in 1.4.8+), and improve audit tooling to reconcile audit log vs meter counts. Short-term = upgrade to 1.4.9, run reconcile to identify duplicates, issue credit.
owen: I'll run the staging sim later today and paste results here. If we find additional collector edge cases we'll patch collector dedupe to use event_id+replay_id fallback.
elena: assigning to @owen and @cs_jess for follow-up with customer; I'll update billing once we have `duplicates.json`. :white_check_mark:
